strategies.name: Constant baseline (15 %)
strategies.description: Fixed low-flow cooling — the vehicle's default setting.

strategies.name: Constant full cooling
strategies.description: Pump at 100 % for the whole charge (conservative rule).

strategies.name: Constant minimal-feasible (23.9 %)
strategies.description: Smallest constant level that satisfies T_max ≤ T_safe − margin on the twin (bisection).

strategies.name: Original optimiser (open loop)
strategies.description: 18×100 s plan from the original max-temperature penalty / finite-difference optimiser.

strategies.name: PDE-constrained optimum (open loop)
strategies.description: 18×100 s plan from the adjoint-based PDE-constrained optimiser (pointwise state constraint, Moreau–Yosida penalty).

strategies.name: Closed-loop MPC (live twin)
strategies.description: Receding-horizon control from the live digital twin: no prior knowledge of the defect, re-estimated every 30 s, re-optimised every 60 s by the adjoint PDE-constrained optimiser.
